static_traits.name: Lin Siya
static_traits.educational_background: 正在攻读Degree in fine arts（Fine Arts）
static_traits.social_status: 在艺术学院有一些朋友，但难以向他人敞开心扉；因not安全感与同学Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前not yet经历类似心理问题，not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能够具体描述情境；倾向关注负面反馈、negate正面信息；自我评价消极；配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管热爱绘画并立志创作壁画，但持续相信自己在艺术领域永远not会成功，这一思维模式导致Self-doubt与not足感。
basic_info.core_demands: 因Self-doubt与失败感影响艺术发展并造成痛苦而寻求咨询。
growth_experiences: 进入艺术学院后开始频繁与同学比较，看到同班同学的才华与作品，逐渐形成“自己not如人”的认知，随之产生强烈的Self-doubt与not足感。
在近几个月里收到对作品的反馈后，因将反馈理解为负面而进一步加重“I am not good enough、not会成功”的信念；同时对正面反馈难以接纳，倾向忽略和贬低。

core_beliefs: 我永远not够好，without法在艺术领域取得成功

special_situations.event: Receives feedback on the work from professors or classmates and interprets it as negative
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有人提出批评或指出问题，就说明I am not good enough、会一直失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍练习、寻求他人认可以缓解not安，但对正面反馈予以negate

special_situations.event: Sees classmates' excellent work and talent in class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not达到或超过同龄人的水平，就说明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断与他人比较、加倍练习或回避开始新项目
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我比他们差，I am a failure

special_situations.event: Starting or preparing to start a new painting project
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能保证结果完美，就会失败并被评价为not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or procrastinates starting new projects to avoid possible failure

special_situations.event: Worries after art class about work quality and others' reactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有得到他人的明确肯定，我的价值与能力才成立；否则就说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeks recognition and reassurance from others (validation)以短暂缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果他们not认可我，就证明我have not能力

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be affirmed and recognized, proving I have ability and achieving success in the art field
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心被视为not如人、因此感到羞耻与被疏离
defense_goal: 通过寻求外部认可来缓解Anxiety与Self-doubt
Avoiding and procrastinating on new projects to reduce the possibility of failure and criticism

object_relations.self_representation: A student who is not good enough and prone to failure
A person with inferiority who needs others' recognition to feel valuable
object_relations.object_representation: Talented competitors who make one feel daunted (classmates)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides identifying and acknowledging positive feedback or past achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识认为这些正面证据“not算数”或是在粉饰现实（移情：将他人视为not可靠的安慰者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平静但坚持负面框架，强调负面例子来negate积极证据。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to set goals or take action for a new project
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将not yet来的not确定等同于必然失败，认为开始行动会导致被negate（移情：把外界视为潜在批判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调风险与条件not完备，提出多项假设作为not行动理由，语气谨慎、审慎。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked how others view one's work and exploring one's feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 假设他人会看not起自己、对作品持负面评价（移情：Projection他人为批判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use“他们会觉得……”之类的表述，语气not确定但坚信他人负面看法。

manifestations: 在艺术学院虽有朋友但难以敞开心扉，因not安全感与同学Relationship tension
Worries about others' evaluations of the work, forming psychological distance
outcomes: Avoids starting new projects; learning and creation affected

manifestations: 面对创作选择与行动的Freedom时感到失败风险hard to bear
Escapes making choices and bearing consequences through avoidance and procrastination
outcomes: Action paralysis and delaying creative work
满意度下降与Career development受阻

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 假设他人会看not起自己的作品、会negate自己
After class, presumes classmates and professors hold negative views of them

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Harsh self-criticism and disparaging one's own ability
设定完美标准，因not确定而not敢开始新项目

positive_force: Love of painting and willingness to keep investing in it
Has creativity and has completed challenging projects
Able to notice problem patterns and willing to seek help
There is a certain peer support network (friends at the art academy)
negative_force: Excessive comparison and inferiority, relying on external recognition
negate正面反馈、心理过滤负面信息
Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking，过度概括
Avoids and procrastinates on new projects, causing blocked action
对他人评价的读心与预测加剧Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids or delays starting a new painting project
antecedent: Worrying about work quality after art class ends
Fear of failure when preparing to start a new project
看到同学的优秀作品后产生自卑与Anxiety
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次失败视为全面失败（非黑即白与过度概括），并灾难化预测not yet来受到negate
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential failure and others' negative evaluations to protect self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Academic and artistic development are hindered; creative input and output decline, and satisfaction decreases

target_behavior.behavior: Frequently seeks recognition and reassurance from others (validation)
antecedent: Doubting one's ability after art class
target_behavior.core_reason: 自我价值高度依赖外部评价，认为have not他人肯定就证明自己not够好
target_behavior.function: Obtains brief reassurance and confirmation of self-worth
target_behavior.consequence: Self-efficacy难以内化，依赖性增强，Relationship tension

target_behavior.behavior: 对自己进行严苛的自我批评与negate正面信息
antecedent: Only attending to negative snippets when reviewing feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: 心理过滤与negate正面思维模式巩固“I am not good enough”的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 维持熟悉的认知框架以减少not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety and self-doubt worsen，注意力与LearningDecreased efficiency
